source.label: GloFAS v4 river discharge (Copernicus Emergency Management Service) via the Open-Meteo Flood API

wmo.report: WMO State of Global Water Resources 2025 (published September 2026)
wmo.as_reported: 36 % of the global river-basin area had below- or much-below-normal flow in 2025, 21 % above; only about a third of rivers were in the normal range, the fewest since 1991; terrestrial water storage 42 % below normal; simulations from 13 global hydrological models
wmo.note: reported by the WMO, not measured here; the annual report has no live feed, so the panel follows the same model family day by day instead

note: Modelled river discharge, not gauge readings: GloFAS runs a hydrological model on observed weather, so the level is approximate and the anomaly against the model's own climatology is what to read. The record starts in 2000, so 1982 and 1997 cannot be shown; 2015 and 2023 can.
